exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to ask again, to repeat a question, to ask to repeat
to entreat, to beg, to beseech, to prevail (upon)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расспроси́ть — to question, to make inquiries (about); переспроси́ть — to ask again, to repeat a question, to ask to repeat; допроси́ть — to interrogate; упроси́ть — to entreat, to beg, to beseech, to prevail (upon).
